acceptance_criteria: Every rule in the class docblock rule table is pinned by at least one data-provider assertion.
An accent is folded away, but "c-cedilla" keeps its /s/ instead of becoming /k/.
Phonetic("pt") returns the same code as PhoneticPortuguese for the same word.
behavior_anchors: portuguese word -> PhoneticPortuguese::phonetic_word -> readable phonetic key
goal: Add a documented Portuguese phonetic algorithm as PhoneticPortuguese and register it as language "pt" in Phonetic.
non_goals: Changing any already shipped language class.
